name: Erode
description: You use strands of arcane energy to erode the defenses of a creature within a moderate (20 unit) distance if your spell check beats the target's resilience. While you concentrate on this spell, the target's physical and aetheric mitigation each decrease by 1 at the start of each round, down to a minimum of 0. If you do not roll at least 2 successes, instead of concentration, the spell lasts a minute but also targets you.
charge: The target's physical and aetheric mitigation are immediately set to 0.
